title: Decarbonization Capital Plan Report Data
description: Data contract for the decarb-capital-plan template — a fork of the decarb-plan report for a single already-decided measures package (no multi-option/plan-A-vs-B analysis). Five sections: Summary, Measures, Financial, and Impact are populated from the engine-derived engagement record; Implementation Considerations is optional and only appears when supplied.

property.description: Core property identification. Required — an omitted or empty block renders literal placeholder text on the cover (known failure mode, see decarb template history). Renders the cover header and meta bar.

address.description: Full street address including city, state.

gfa_sqft.description: Gross floor area in square feet.

gfa_m2.description: Gross floor area in m². Optional; supports kWh·m⁻² derivations.

prepared_for.description: Client the plan is prepared for — renders on the cover eyebrow and as the running-header brand on every interior page (no client name is hardcoded in the template).

report_date.description: ISO 8601 date shown on the cover.

narrative.description: Prose summary of the decided measures package and expected outcomes (2-4 paragraphs).

measures.description: Section 2 — Measures. The decided measures package (already selected — no option comparison).

items.description: Each decided measure. Engine-sourced financial/emissions fields — never LLM-computed.

type.description: Measure family (e.g. 'Electrification', 'Envelope', 'Solar PV'). Used as the roadmap group header.

like_for_like_cost.description: Like-for-like replacement cost in USD (0 for pure add-ons).

incentives.description: Rebates/incentives applied to this measure in USD.

energy_savings_kwh.description: Annual electric energy savings in kWh/yr — Audette's own real per-measure figure (energy_consumption_savings_electricity), never an engineering estimate. Omit rather than estimate when Audette has no figure for this measure.

tenant_utility_savings.description: Stabilized annual tenant-share utility $ savings (engine-computed, shown separately, never merged with landlord savings).

ancillary_revenue.description: Stabilized annual ancillary revenue (e.g. EV charging, solar export).

status.description: Measure status shown in the roadmap's Status column. Defaults to 'Recommended' when omitted.

measures_considered.description: Measures analyzed during the engagement but NOT recommended into the package. Rendered at the bottom of the Section 2 roadmap table in muted styling with status 'Analyzed — not recommended'; absent fields render as em-dashes, never estimated.

emissions_savings_tco2e.description: Annual emissions reduction in tCO2e/yr, if computed during screening.

incremental_cost.description: Incremental cost over like-for-like, USD, if computed during screening.

reason.description: Why the measure was not recommended (shown as a sub-line under the name).

financial.description: Section 3 — Financial. Single-package investment summary (no A/B plan comparison).

total_investment.description: Sum of all measures' total_cost, USD.

total_incentives.description: Sum of all measures' incentives, USD.

annual_savings.description: Total stabilized annual owner-share savings + ancillary revenue, USD/yr.

npv.description: Net present value of the package, USD, if computed.

irr_pct.description: Internal rate of return, percent, if computed.

exit_year.description: Presumed exit (disposition) year used for the value bridge and implied value uplift.

exit_cap.description: Presumed exit capitalization rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.0625 = 6.25%).

bridge.description: Value Creation Bridge (Exhibit 3.1) — cumulative operating flows over the hold plus the capitalized exit value uplift at the presumed exit cap. Preferred over the legacy operating-basis 'waterfall' shape; when present it replaces it. All figures engine-computed — omit entirely rather than estimate any field.

cumulative_utility_savings.description: Sum of realized annual energy/utility savings across the modeled hold, USD.

fine_avoidance.description: Cumulative BPS fines avoided over the hold, USD. Bar only drawn when non-zero.

exit_value_uplift.description: Capitalized exit value uplift at the presumed exit cap, USD.

net.description: Net value creation across the bridge, USD.

cashflow.description: Optional year-by-year cashflow series — powers both the cumulative-line chart and the detailed Annual Cashflow table (borrowed from decarb's own collapsible per-plan table).

cumulative_usd.description: Cumulative net cashflow at this year, USD (negative = still in payback).

incremental_capex_usd.description: This year's capital outlay, USD (0 in years with no install).

utility_savings_usd.description: This year's recurring operating utility savings, USD — the real, engine-computed annual figure, not capitalized to any exit.

fine_avoidance_usd.description: This year's avoided BPS fines, USD. The Fine Avoidance column only renders when at least one year is non-zero.

value_uplift_usd.description: Implied value uplift = this year's NOI impact ÷ presumed exit cap, USD. Omit rather than estimate; renders as — when absent.

waterfall.description: LEGACY operating cost/savings bridge shape — superseded by financial.bridge (which, when present, is rendered instead). This shape models no disposition — it must NEVER contain an exit-capitalized figure (no exit_value_uplift / capitalized_utility_savings / net_value_creation). incentives and incremental_capex are plan-level, exit-free sums; cumulative_utility_savings is REALIZED savings summed across the modeled cashflow years (no capitalization); net_position is the real final-year cumulative cash position from that same series. Omit entirely rather than estimate any field.

cumulative_utility_savings.description: Sum of realized annual utility savings across the modeled cashflow years — not capitalized to any exit event.

net_position.description: The modeled cashflow series' real final-year cumulative value (negative = still in payback at that point).

reduction_pct.description: Percent reduction, computed as (baseline - post) / baseline if omitted.

combined_post_retrofit_tco2e.description: Post-retrofit annual emissions (tCO2e/yr) after measures AND grid decarbonization combined.

grid_decarb_reduction_pct.description: Additional emissions-reduction fraction (0-1) attributable to grid decarbonization beyond the measures-only headline.

basis.description: Marks post_retrofit_tco2e/reduction_pct as measures-only (grid decarbonization reported separately). Absent => legacy combined figure.

post_retrofit_kwh.description: Projected post-retrofit annual energy use, kWh/yr. Approximated by applying the engine's overall emissions_reduction_pct ratio to the kWh baseline (no independently modeled per-fuel kWh projection exists yet) — not an exact figure.

net_purchased_kwh.description: Post-retrofit purchased energy net of on-site generation (kWh/yr). Includes solar PV offset — the second, generation-inclusive figure.

net_purchased_eui.description: Net purchased EUI (kWh/m2/yr) net of on-site generation.

basis.description: Marks post_retrofit_kwh as excluding on-site generation. Absent => legacy figure that may include generation; the template then uses a neutral label.

regulatory.description: Building performance standard (BPS) compliance context, if applicable to this asset's jurisdiction.

applicable_standard.description: e.g. 'NYC LL97', 'Boston BERDO', or 'Not applicable' if none.

annual_fine_avoided_usd.description: Estimated annual fine avoided by the decided package, USD/yr, if applicable.

note.description: Free-text regulatory context (e.g. covered-buildings registry citation).

trajectory.description: Optional year-by-year EUI and GHG intensity series (engine-derived from aggregateTrajectory; EUI is a ratio-derived projection off the same reduction curve — see projector notes). Powers the EUI/GHGi vs. compliance-threshold exhibit. Omit entirely if the engine trajectory isn't available rather than estimate one.

ghgi_bau_kgco2_m2.description: Business-as-usual GHG intensity, kgCO2e/m²/yr, for reference.

bps_thresholds.description: Optional building-performance-standard threshold lines drawn on the EUI (metric 'eui') and GHGi (metric 'ghgi') trajectory charts as horizontal dashed limits with a right-aligned label. Values must be in the chart's own unit (EUI: kWh/m²/yr; GHGi: kgCO2e/m²/yr) — never converted at render time. Real, cited thresholds only — omit rather than estimate.

metric.description: Which trajectory chart the threshold belongs to.

value.description: Threshold value, in the chart's own unit.

label.description: Short label drawn right-aligned above the line (e.g. 'LL97 2030 limit').

source.description: Citation for the threshold (program document, statute, registry).

crrem.description: Real CRREM compliance pathway, only present when the engagement was derived with a crrem_region. NEVER hand-drawn or estimated — must come from the engine's fetched pathway verbatim, or be omitted.

eui_kwh_m2yr.description: CRREM's own real EUI-native target for this year, if the fetched pathway includes one. Never derived from the carbon figure via a grid factor — omit rather than approximate.

blend.description: Per-property-type GFA blend used to build a mixed-use CRREM pathway.

narrative.description: Prose discussion of sequencing, tenant/owner coordination, permitting, or other execution considerations.

considerations.description: Discrete implementation items (risks, dependencies, timing notes).

incentive_programs.description: Section 5 — Incentive Programs. Real, sourced incentive/rebate/financing research applicable to this asset (from the incentive research agent, when available). Omit entirely rather than hand-estimate a program.

description.description: What the program offers and how it applies to this asset/measures.

compliance_notes.description: Section 5 — Compliance Notes. How this building performs against real building-performance-standard/compliance programs applicable to its jurisdiction (e.g. WA Clean Buildings Act, Seattle BEPS) — real, sourced status only. Omit entirely rather than fabricate a compliance status or target; this section is intentionally unpopulated until a real, cited compliance-rules data source exists (mirroring the rigor of CRREM region / incentive-rules.json).

description.description: How this building performs against the program's real, cited target/threshold.
